nonCustomerNote:
Credits that reach our account but buy no Pian Yi subscription package. Matched against the same haystack as `eaters` (raw counterparty + description), whole-word, before the eater map is tried. `account` names the contra account the journal line will face.

kind `event_order` is the exception that still writes rows: a one-off catered event is bought and eaten on one date, so it gets an order AND a delivery row dated the day after the payment, and the two cancel to a zero balance. `portions` is what the event was; null means nobody has told us yet and the payer is held back rather than guessed at. `existingOrderId` reuses an order the database already holds instead of inserting a second one.

Every other kind writes nothing here and is booked by the journal backfill.
